scenes.text: A planet two hundred light-years away hums a single steady note.
scenes.art_prompt: a distant blue planet against the stars, 3d render

scenes.text: It has held that tone for millions of years, drifting only a little.
scenes.art_prompt: a planet with a faint glowing atmosphere, 3d render

scenes.text: Astronomers matched the frequency to the ringing of a struck bell.
scenes.art_prompt: a radio waveform on a telescope screen, 3d render

scenes.text: The note is the planet's own atmosphere, still vibrating from an impact long ago.
scenes.art_prompt: an impact scar on a planet's surface, dramatic, 3d render

scenes.text:
The collision ended long before the dinosaurs.
The sky has been singing about it ever since.
scenes.art_prompt: a planet ringing with soft concentric waves, wonder, 3d render

scenes.text: Follow Cosmic Wonders for the next wonder.
scenes.art_prompt: a calm planet in deep space, one bright point, final, 3d render
